title: V526e / V549 / V549b -> CURRENT CO-SIGNATURE & ATTITUDE-CLOUD LINEAGE COURT

target_blob_stability.conclusion: The current cloud implementation lineage split predates the frozen VT3 base and is unchanged at the D03 base.

finite_verdict.historical_v526e: Broad design family: branch co-signature plus profile covariance, with required outputs branch_co_signature_summary, profile_cluster_summary, profile_relation_vector.
finite_verdict.v549: Implements genuine respondent-level recursive-branch-conditioned pairwise association: binary V548 branch membership x candidate categorical question response, scored by Cramer's V.
finite_verdict.v549b: Retains branch-node anchors and adds answer/presence anchors; all remain binary-anchor x candidate-question categorical-response pairwise Cramer's-V associations.
finite_verdict.current_position_signature: Within-current-question position-coordinate x response association; no recursive branch cohort input.
finite_verdict.current_relation_cosignature: Within-current-question-frame permitted feature x response association; no recursive branch cohort or cross-question respondent join.
finite_verdict.current_attitude_cloud: Same-respondent cross-question ordered-pair diagnostic selecting one modal joint response cell, with a directional conditional event probability plus pairwise NMI/Cramer's V.
material_loss: historical profile_cluster_summary not realized/preserved in this lineage
historical profile_relation_vector not realized/preserved in this lineage
recursive branch membership is not supplied to current cloud/signature functions
branch-conditioned cotravel present in V549/V549b is absent from current native cloud/signature path
higher-order/k-way response topology is not preserved by current cloud artifact

concepts.name: demographic_position_signature_of_branch
concepts.definition: Position-coordinate distribution/association among respondents actually belonging to a defined branch cohort.
concepts.not_equivalent_to: Associating demographics with a question response while setting branch_id equal to the question.

concepts.name: relation_cosignature_associated_with_branch
concepts.definition: Association between actual branch membership and other relation/attitude responses in the same respondent universe.
concepts.not_equivalent_to: Generic co-resident feature association in one question frame.

concepts.name: same_respondent_question_response_cotravel
concepts.definition: Cross-question association proved by matching the same respondent identifiers across question frames.
concepts.not_equivalent_to: Shared metadata, ontology, driver IDs, or unrelated marginals.

concepts.name: branch_conditioned_cotravel
concepts.definition: Same-respondent response association where the anchor cohort is actual membership in a reconstructed branch.
concepts.not_equivalent_to: A synthetic branch key or question-level scope.

concepts.name: historical_profile_covariance
concepts.definition: V526e design family intended to preserve co-variation/cluster/vector structure for later profile generation.
concepts.not_equivalent_to: Any single pairwise association score or current table name.

concepts.name: generic_within_frame_feature_association
concepts.definition: Association between two columns already co-resident in the same row frame.
concepts.not_equivalent_to: Cross-question cotravel unless the frame itself lawfully contains cross-question response variables.

concepts.name: conditional_empirical_distribution
concepts.definition: Full governed P(response topology | exact governed empirical predicate, scope), with support/provenance.
concepts.not_equivalent_to: A single association score, modal joint cell, or selected conditional event.
